Name: Mimikyu - Cat Dog Replacer
Author: SihaRakhet
Description:
I love Mimikyu almost too much! XD So I really wanted to change my cat into an adorable little Mimikyu! I looked to see if it was already done and didn't find it to be so. Though I did find this amazing one for Krobus by ChiChain on the Chucklefish forums.

Linked here: http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/mimikyu-1-0.131359/

With their permission and a lot of talking back and forth about the animations, we were able to do it! ChiChain made all the walking and standing animations, while I just filled in the blanks. And also we made it for the dog as well! 

I wasn't originally intending it because the dog has a few extra animations, but I think I got it all lined up pretty well. I wasn't able to test it in game so for sure let me know if the dog's run cycle looks a little off or anything you may notice.

Unfortunately Mimikyu will still meow or bark, but hey, what can ya do. x3 Also feel free to upload your own in-game shots! I'd love to see Mimikyu on your farm!

I hope you enjoy this even half as much as I do!

[b]Installation:[/b] Just drop the Content file into the main Stardew Valley folder and overwrite when asked.
